title: Quality Inspector (NDT/QMS)
description: Overview & Responsibilities We are seeking a highly meticulous Quality Inspector to join our Supply Chain department. In this critical operational role, you will be the frontline safeguard for the Ebara Elliott Energy's Quality Management System, ensuring the absolute integrity of precision turbomachinery parts and components. Your primary focus will involve rigorous quality checks on critical materials destined for steam turbines, centrifugal compressors, and both multistage and cryogenic pumps. By verifying that all incoming materials, in-process assemblies, and final products meet our stringent engineering standards, you will directly support our commitment to delivering world-class, reliable turbomachinery equipment. Job Responsibilities Interpret Technical Documentation: Read, analyze, and accurately apply complex engineering documentation, including work orders, assembly and manufacturing blueprints, special instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and material specifications specific to turbomachinery. Execute Precision Measurements: Utilize a comprehensive array of manual and digital measuring devices to perform dimensional inspections, ensuring that turbine, compressor, and pump components strictly conform to drawing tolerances, quality standards, and completeness requirements. Conduct NDT Inspections: Perform thorough incoming, in-process, and final Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections across various stages of the supply chain lifecycle to identify surface and subsurface defects. Manage Quality Documentation: Initiate and process critical quality control documentation, including scrap and rework reports, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and comprehensive quality action reports to track and resolve discrepancies. Maintain Equipment Calibration: Oversee the calibration processes and maintain meticulous logs for all inspection and measuring equipment, encompassing both company-issued quality center tools and personally owned precision instruments. Verify Incoming Supply Chain Materials: Inspect, identify, and formally approve incoming raw materials and outsourced components, verifying they match engineering drawings and material specifications before being released to the floor. Execute Operational Priorities: Effectively manage daily workflow by receiving, prioritizing, and adhering to inspection schedules and urgent operational targets set by supply chain management. Escalate Non-Conformances: Proactively identify, thoroughly document, and raise immediate awareness regarding any material or procedural non-conformances to the appropriate engineering and management teams. Uphold Safety and 5S Standards: Strictly adhere to all facility safety protocols and maintain workstations in a clean, organized, and highly functional operating condition. Author Inspection Reports: Draft clear, concise, and highly accurate inspection reports to maintain a permanent, traceable record for all evaluated parts. Validate Supplier Compliance: Review and analyze Material Test Reports (MTRs) provided by external suppliers to guarantee absolute compliance with Elliott's proprietary material specifications. Perform Final Release Inspections: Conduct rigorous final quality inspections on all finished turbomachinery parts and components prior to their approval for shipment or inventory storage. Required Qualifications & Skills: Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of dedicated inspection and quality control experience within an industrial, manufacturing, or supply chain environment. Rotating Equipment & Turbomachinery experience with an OEM is highly preferred. NDT Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding of core Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methodologies, specifically Penetrant Testing (PT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Radiographic Testing (RT), and Magnetic Particle Testing (MT). Advanced Certifications (Preferred): Highly qualified candidates will possess an active ASNT Level 2 certification in Visual Testing (VT) or possess the prerequisite training to obtain it. Equipment Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience utilizing a broad spectrum of specialized NDT equipment and advanced precision measuring tools. Dimensional Tool Mastery: High proficiency in reading and operating manual and digital measuring tools, including micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, height gauges, and related inspection instruments. NDT Hardware Operation: Practical familiarity with operating non-destructive testing hardware, such as magnetic particle yokes/machines, ultrasonic flaw detectors, digital thickness indicators, and ultraviolet (black light) equipment. Technical Comprehension: Exceptional ability to accurately read and interpret complex mechanical scopes of work, detailed blueprints, special engineering procedures, and technical component specifications. Operational Flexibility: Willingness to work overtime and alternating shifts as required to support fluctuating plant operations, production schedules, and supply chain demands. Education: A high school diploma or equivalent is required; candidates with advanced or specialized technical training in quality control, metallurgy, or machining will be given strong preference. Software Skills: Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for report generation, data entry, and internal communication. Customers throughout the world choose Elliott for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. Elliott’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. title: QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)
description: QA Automation Engineer (AI-First) Location: Bengaluru, India (remote), with daily overlap with our UK team Engagement Type: Full-time contract, 3 months then ongoing Experience: 2–4 years Reports to: Technical Project Manager Compensation: India-based, aligned to experience and location About MarcoPolo Learning MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners. Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators. Role Overview We ship fast. AI helps our engineers write code quicker than ever, and we’re about to launch two major web platforms used by thousands of educators. Speed only counts if what reaches teachers works beautifully, every time. We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer who wants to own that quality. You’ll learn our products inside out, help us move from manual checks to smart, AI-assisted automated testing, and become the person the team trusts to say “this is ready.” You’ll work directly with our technical project manager and engineers, get hands-on with the latest AI testing and agent tools, and have room to grow into a broader engineering role as you prove yourself. Key Responsibilities Quality and testing Test new features end to end across our web platforms and mobile apps, thinking like a teacher, a director and an admin, and catch issues before they reach customers. Write clear test cases and acceptance criteria, using AI to generate and expand them quickly. Build and maintain automated regression suites (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or similar) so every release is checked consistently without repetitive manual work. Evaluate and pilot new AI-forward QA testing platforms (self-healing, agent-driven and visual AI testing tools), measure what actually saves time, and help us adopt the ones that work. Verify that reports, dashboards and data exports reflect real user activity accurately. Test user journeys that span systems, such as course completion, certificates and automated customer emails. Log bugs clearly in Jira, reproduce them reliably, and work with engineers until they’re fixed and verified. Release and production support Run pre-release and post-release checks, and help verify hotfixes quickly when something needs attention. Be the first technical line for product questions from our customer-facing team: investigate, resolve what you can, and route the rest with the right detail. Turn recurring questions into simple guides and self-serve answers, so the team can find solutions without waiting. AI and automation Work alongside our automation specialist to test and refine the AI agents and workflows we’re rolling out across the company. Document how our products work, building shared knowledge that helps the whole team and our AI tools. What We’re Looking For A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field (B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA or equivalent), or equivalent hands-on experience. 2–4 years of experience in QA, test automation or software development on web applications. Hands-on experience testing mobile apps on iOS, Android and Amazon (Fire OS) devices, including app store builds and testing across devices and screen sizes. Experience building automated tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar. Working knowledge of at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred) and comfort reading code. An AI-native way of working: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Copilot daily, and you’re curious about AI agents and AI testing tools. Openness to new AI-forward QA testing platforms (e.g. Mabl, Testim, testRigor, Applitools, or AI agents working with Playwright), and the curiosity to try them, compare them and bring the best into our workflow. A sharp eye for detail: you notice when a number, a layout or a flow isn’t quite right, and you can explain exactly why. Clear, structured bug reporting and documentation. Comfort with web fundamentals: browser dev tools, APIs and testing across devices and screen sizes. Ownership and follow-through: you see an issue through to resolution and speak up early when something is off. Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working with technical and non-technical colleagues in the UK time zone. Bonus points Jira or Asana experience in an agile sprint setup. Exposure to a headless CMS (e.g. Strapi), SQL, or tools like Postman. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) or AWS. Experience with no-code automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Make) or email platforms like Customer.io. An ISTQB Foundation certification or similar. Interest in education, ed-tech or early childhood learning. What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days First 30 days: learn our products and users, take on release checks, and log your first well-documented bugs. By 60 days: own testing for a product area and ship your first automated regression tests. By 90 days: run release QA independently, with automated coverage on our key user journeys and a recommendation on which AI testing tools we should adopt. What to Be Ready to Demonstrate Be ready to walk us through test automation you’ve built: what you chose to automate, how you structured it, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a short, paid practical exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information. What We Offer Experience with a growing international education company, working closely with our UK-based team. Real ownership: what you test and automate goes straight to thousands of educators. Daily exposure to AI agents, AI testing tools and modern engineering practices. Mentorship and a clear path to grow into a broader engineering role. Compensation benchmarked to the Bengaluru/India market, based on your experience and location. Remote working, plus 15 days paid annual leave and Indian public holidays. A collaborative, mission-driven team at the intersection of education, media and technology. Why Join Us If you’re curious about AI and want your work to matter, this is the role. You’ll help shape how a growing global education company builds and tests its products in the AI era, and grow your skills faster than you would almost anywhere else. Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.
